title: Size of the pyramid at El Mirador

tellings.quote: for the last 5 minutes I was walking on the pyramid straight.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns tells podcast host Jesse Michels about visiting El Mirador, an ancient site in the jungle of Guatemala, in 2024. He says the pyramid there is so huge that he had been walking straight on it for five minutes before he realised it. He tells it to show how much bigger and older these ancient builders' work may be than people imagine.
